title: Create a matrix reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for create a matrix should include: strategy:, matrix:, runs-on:, ${{ matrix..
answer.example:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests
